candidate_boundary.source: all currently sensed fuel tracks plus existing simulator action slots
candidate_boundary.reference_pool: all route-qualified ordinary rows plus independent 18-offset route-qualified oracle rows for every currently sensed target
candidate_boundary.recall_limit: snapshot-bounded deterministic oracle over currently sensed tracks, not a simulator-optimality oracle
candidate_boundary.expanded_goals: one selectable direct approach per sensed target in stable distance/buffer order, followed by bounded approach offsets; oracle adds 18 offsets per sensed target
candidate_boundary.execution: selected XY endpoint and sensor buffer identity flow through the paired native goal override; slot-3 native controller revalidates the sensed track each physics step and steers pickup bearing toward its current XY throughout approach; endpoint alignment uses native swept clearance checks; action mask/mechanisms remain simulator-owned
candidate_boundary.target_controller_override: restricted to the neural offense in slot 3 and a paired collect action; each physics step requires the same sensor-buffer track to remain present, within perception timeout, and within 1.0 m of snapshot XY; use current track delta for slot-3 fuel_delta and pickup target throughout approach, then derive terminal intake bearing from current track XY relative to the selected endpoint; on loss or buffer reuse, clear goal/heading override and end the macro for a fresh candidate decision
candidate_boundary.target_execution_boundary: native collector is geometric and may collect any physically contacted eligible fuel; selected sensed target is an intended route goal and terminal bearing, not an exclusive pickup constraint
candidate_boundary.selectable_order: legacy eight action rows, then direct goals for sensed targets beyond the native top-four ordered by robot distance and sensor buffer index, then legacy offsets; K8 prefix is unchanged
candidate_boundary.heading_execution: selected collection track supplies a dynamically revalidated pickup bearing throughout approach; at the endpoint native controller applies swept static/observed-robot turn-clearance checks before final alignment
candidate_boundary.continue_gap: one dynamically revalidated continue row follows the stable K-prefix; target loss, route invalidity, expiry, completion, phase incompatibility, and episode reset clear it
candidate_boundary.selectable_pool: ordinary prefix at K=8/16/32 plus at most one appended continue row; K8 IDs/order remain unchanged, while K16/K32 prioritize direct recall of sensed targets beyond top-four before approach-offset variants
candidate_boundary.hysteresis: when a commitment is active, apply the same fixed switch-cost utility penalty to every feasible non-continue row for C1/C2/D1/D2; continuation remains dynamically revalidated
candidate_boundary.route_feasibility: route and endpoint clearance plus bearing-aligned collection capture-envelope eligibility; selected-target pickup bearing is commanded through approach, with terminal alignment subject to native swept-clearance checks
candidate_boundary.capture_estimate: bearing-aligned capture envelope eligibility proxy from sensed target geometry; native controller steers toward the selected track, while physical capture remains simulator-authoritative

capture_feasibility.basis: candidate goal XY and target XY projected into inferred target-bearing frame
capture_feasibility.orientation: bearing-aligned eligibility geometry; selected target drives native pickup bearing and terminal alignment remains subject to swept-clearance checks
capture_feasibility.authority: candidate eligibility proxy only; native gamepiece collision/capture logic is authoritative

candidate_boundary.plan_a_policy_support: all reachable legal SE(2) graph nodes crossed with currently executable drive/intake/score/ferry/defense behaviors; carrying dumper ferry pairs are excluded because native release may preempt the selected endpoint
candidate_boundary.plan_a_support_membership: one model-independent shortest-path pass over legal SE(2) graph plus vectorized behavior-specific endpoint/target constraints; independent of learned P
candidate_boundary.plan_a_intake_descriptor: intake pairs retain exact sensed target slot and require a bearing-aligned capture-geometry envelope
candidate_boundary.plan_a_heading_semantics: each selected legal SE(2) node carries its terminal heading; the simulator stops at the XY goal, checks sampled static rotation and observed-robot point forecast, then aligns; intake headings are capture-geometry constrained, score headings are hub-facing within 5 degrees; controllable ferry headings satisfy the native 45-degree release cone
candidate_boundary.plan_a_drive_semantics: action 7 holds unless the Plan A adapter pairs it with its explicit validated planner goal, retaining native route and obstacle guards; legal dumper traversal remains supported while loaded, while carrying dumper ferry action 6 remains excluded because it may release fuel before reaching the selected endpoint
candidate_boundary.plan_a_goal_constraints: score pairs require a safe score-grid endpoint; executable ferry pairs require carried fuel and current ferry endpoint, while dumper ferry pairs are excluded; defense pairs require the current intercept/post endpoint
candidate_boundary.plan_a_behavior_heading_constraints: intake headings must keep the exact sensed target within the forward capture envelope; score headings must face the HUB within 5 degrees; controllable ferry headings satisfy the simulator's 45-degree release cone; drive and defense headings use guarded terminal alignment
candidate_boundary.plan_a_ppo: sample and recompute log probability over the exact frozen node-major support mask and order
candidate_boundary.plan_a_route_metadata: frozen shortest-path parent tree including the root-pose connector and terminal headings; this is graph-route metadata, while execution remains XY AD* with swept SE(2) checks and guarded terminal alignment
candidate_boundary.plan_a_candidate_k: not used; candidate_k applies only to Plan C candidate scorers

gate_calibration.reason: manifest API has no trusted calibration-report validator binding
